kilauea_notices.title: HAWAIIAN VOLCANO OBSERVATORY DAILY UPDATE
kilauea_notices.message: HVO Kilauea ORANGE/WATCH - Kīlauea volcano is erupting. Precursory overflows, which began on September 7, continued for the past 24 hours. A forecast window of September 9-10 is likely for the start of episode 55 fountaining.

mauna_loa_notices.title: HAWAIIAN VOLCANO OBSERVATORY MONTHLY UPDATE
mauna_loa_notices.message: HVO Haleakala GREEN/NORMAL - No activity of concern for Haleakalā.
